build_MistralCommonBackend_tokenizer: build a MistralCommonBackend tokenizer from a local path or Hugging Face model repo
test_apply_chat_template: test the apply_chat_template method with a conversation list containing role and content dicts
create_encode_text: create tokenized input ids from a text string using the MistralCommonBackend encode method
summarize_decode_tokens: summarize decoding a list of token ids back to a text string with skip_special_tokens
run_save_pretrained_tokenizer: run saving the tokenizer to a directory and optionally push to the Hugging Face hub
